name: Copper ring smelted from self-harvested malachite ore

mentions.name: Copper ring smelted from self-harvested malachite ore
mentions.description: A hands-on DIY metallurgy project that smelts malachite ore with flux and charcoal to produce pure copper, pours it into an ingot mold, and hammers it into a handmade ring made from metal the maker collected and processed personally.
mentions.problem: Gold is too hard and silver can be somewhat dangerous to work with, so malachite is used as a safe alternative source metal for smelting copper.
mentions.audience: The author themself, as a personal hands-on hobby project
mentions.source_excerpt: Basically: smelt the malachite with flux and charcoal to get pure copper, flow that into an ingot mold, hammer it into shape. Then I’ll have my own ring, with metal I collected with my own hands
